title: URL state and History API
description: Practice url state and history api through a self-contained HTML browser interaction, a failing starter, a corrected solution and repeatable regression checks.
objectives: Explain url state and history api in real browser state and semantics
Repair the broken DOM interaction without unsafe HTML insertion
